rules.title: Cap on upfront payments and security deposit
rules.requirement: At or before the start of a tenancy, a lessor or agent may not require more than first month's rent, last month's rent, a security deposit equal to first month's rent, and the cost of a key and lock. The deposit must be properly deposited and a statement of condition given.
rules.coverage_text: All residential leases/tenancies except vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less.
rules.exemptions_text: Does not apply to vacation/recreational tenancies of one hundred days or less.

exemption_tests.description: Lease, rental, occupancy or tenancy of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purpose.

rules.ambiguity_note: Introductory paragraph of clause (b) appears in two versions (until Aug 1, 2025 and as amended effective Aug 1, 2025, adding 'agent of the lessor'); the later version is in force.
rules.quoted_span: (b) At or prior to the commencement of any tenancy, no lessor or agent of the lessor may require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay, to the lessor or to an agent of the lessor, any amount in excess of the following:
rules.penalty: See subsections (6) and (7): forfeiture and treble damages for certain violations.

rules.title: Fee in lieu of security deposit (regulatory authorization)
rules.requirement: The executive office of housing and livable communities may promulgate regulations allowing an optional fee in lieu of a security deposit, capped at one month's rent in total, with the tenant able to choose a full deposit instead.
rules.exemptions_text: Vacation/recreational tenancies of 100 days or less are excluded from section 15B.

exemption_tests.description: Tenancy of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purpose.

rules.key_value: Fee total not to exceed 1 month's rent
rules.ambiguity_note: Authorizes regulations; text does not state that regulations have been issued.
rules.quoted_span: (C) limit the total sum of the fee or recurring payments, regardless of the duration of the lease and any extensions thereto, to an amount not to exceed 1 month's rent;

rules.title: No later demand for excess advance rent or deposit
rules.requirement: After a tenancy begins, a lessor or successor may not demand rent in advance beyond the current month's rent or a security deposit above the statutory limit.
rules.coverage_text: Residential tenancies other than short vacation rentals.
rules.exemptions_text: Vacation/recreational tenancies of 100 days or less.

exemption_tests.description: Tenancy of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purpose.

rules.key_value: Advance rent limited to current month
rules.quoted_span: No lessor or successor in interest shall at any time subsequent to the commencement of a tenancy demand rent in advance in excess of the current month's rent or a security deposit in excess of the amount allowed by this section.

rules.title: Security deposit receipt and statement of condition
rules.requirement: A lessor or agent receiving a security deposit must give a signed receipt, and must furnish a separate written statement of the premises' condition listing existing damage, with a prescribed notice, within ten days after tenancy commencement or upon receipt, whichever is later.
rules.coverage_text: Lessors accepting security deposits for residential premises.
rules.exemptions_text: Vacation/recreational tenancies of 100 days or less.

exemption_tests.description: Tenancy of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purpose.

rules.key_value: Statement of condition within 10 days of tenancy start
rules.quoted_span: Any lessor of residential real property, or his agent, who accepts a security deposit from a tenant or prospective tenant shall, upon receipt of such security deposit, or within ten days after commencement of the tenancy, whichever is later, furnish to such tenant or prospective tenant a separate written statement of the present condition of the premises to be leased or rented.

rules.title: Security deposit record-keeping
rules.requirement: Every lessor accepting a security deposit must maintain records of damage, repairs, receipts and statements of condition, make them available for tenant inspection, and keep them for two years after the tenancy ends.
rules.exemptions_text: Vacation/recreational tenancies of 100 days or less.

exemption_tests.description: Tenancy of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purpose.

rules.quoted_span: The lessor or his agent shall maintain said record for each dwelling unit or premises for which a security deposit was accepted for a period of two years from the date of termination of the tenancy or occupancy upon which the security deposit was conditioned.
rules.penalty: Tenant entitled to immediate return of deposit and accrued interest upon wrongful failure to make record available.

rules.title: Separate interest-bearing account for security deposits
rules.requirement: Security deposits must be held in a separate interest-bearing bank account in Massachusetts beyond creditors' claims, not commingled with lessor assets, and the tenant must receive a receipt with bank details within 30 days.
rules.exemptions_text: Vacation/recreational tenancies of 100 days or less.

exemption_tests.description: Tenancy of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purpose.

rules.quoted_span: Any security deposit received by such lessor shall be held in a separate, interest-bearing account in a bank, located within the commonwealth under such terms as will place such deposit beyond the claim of creditors of the lessor, including a foreclosing mortgagee or trustee in bankruptcy, and as will provide for its transfer to a subsequent owner of said property.
rules.penalty: Failure entitles tenant to immediate return of the security deposit.

rules.title: Annual interest on security deposits
rules.requirement: A lessor holding a deposit for one year or longer must pay the tenant interest at 5% per year or the lesser amount actually received from the bank, annually, with a yearly statement.
rules.coverage_text: Lessors holding security deposits for one year or longer.
rules.exemptions_text: Vacation/recreational tenancies of 100 days or less.

exemption_tests.description: Tenancy of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purpose.

rules.key_value: 5% per year or lesser bank interest
rules.quoted_span: A lessor of residential real property who holds a security deposit pursuant to this section for a period of one year or longer from the commencement of the term of the tenancy shall, beginning with the first day of the tenancy, pay interest at the rate of five per cent per year, or other such lesser amount of interest as has been received from the bank where the deposit has been held payable to the tenant at the end of each year of the tenancy.

rules.title: Interest and receipt for last month's rent paid in advance
rules.requirement: A lessor receiving last month's rent in advance must give a detailed receipt and pay the tenant interest at 5% per year or the lesser amount received from the bank.
rules.coverage_text: Lessors receiving last month's rent in advance.
rules.exemptions_text: Vacation/recreational tenancies of 100 days or less.

exemption_tests.description: Tenancy of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purpose.

rules.quoted_span: Any lessor or his agent who receives said rent in advance for the last month of tenancy shall, beginning with the first day of tenancy, pay interest at the rate of five per cent per year or other such lesser amount of interest as has been received from the bank where the deposit has been held.
rules.penalty: Treble the interest owed plus court costs and reasonable attorneys fees if unpaid within 30 days after termination.

rules.title: Return of security deposit and permitted deductions
rules.requirement: The lessor must return the deposit or balance within 30 days after the tenancy ends. Deductions are allowed only for unpaid rent or water charges, unpaid tax escalation increases, and reasonable repair of tenant-caused damage (excluding normal wear and tear), supported by a sworn itemized list.
rules.coverage_text: Residential tenancies where a security deposit is held.
rules.exemptions_text: Vacation/recreational tenancies of 100 days or less.

exemption_tests.description: Tenancy of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purpose.

rules.quoted_span: The lessor shall, within thirty days after the termination of occupancy under a tenancy-at-will or the end of the tenancy as specified in a valid written lease agreement, return to the tenant the security deposit or any balance thereof;  provided, however, that the lessor may deduct from such security deposit for the following:
rules.penalty: See subsections (6) and (7): forfeiture of right to retain deposit; treble damages plus interest, costs and attorney's fees.

rules.title: Transfer of security deposit to successor in interest
rules.requirement: When a lessor transfers interest in the unit, the deposit with accrued interest must be transferred to the successor, who must notify the tenant in writing within 45 days and becomes liable for its return.
rules.coverage_text: Lessors holding security deposits who transfer their interest.
rules.exemptions_text: Granting a mortgage is not a transfer; liability does not apply to cities/towns acquiring title under chapter 60 or certain foreclosing mortgagees. Vacation rentals of 100 days or less excluded.

exemption_tests.description: Tenancy of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purpose.
Successor-liability exemption for cities/towns acquiring title under chapter sixty and chartered financial institution foreclosing mortgagees or mortgagees in possession.

rules.quoted_span: The successor in interest shall, within forty-five days from the date of said transfer, notify the tenant who made such security deposit that such security deposit was transferred to him and that he is holding said security deposit.

rules.title: Forfeiture and treble damages for security deposit violations
rules.requirement: A lessor forfeits the right to retain any deposit portion for failing to comply with specified requirements (account, itemized list, successor transfer, timely return, conflicting lease terms). For certain violations the tenant is awarded three times the deposit plus 5% interest, costs and attorney's fees.
rules.coverage_text: Lessors of residential premises holding security deposits.
rules.exemptions_text: Vacation/recreational tenancies of 100 days or less.

exemption_tests.description: Tenancy of 100 days or less for vacation or recreational purpose.

rules.quoted_span: If the lessor or his agent fails to comply with clauses (a), (d), or (e) of subsection 6, the tenant shall be awarded damages in an amount equal to three times the amount of such security deposit or balance thereof to which the tenant is entitled plus interest at the rate of five per cent from the date when such payment became due, together with court costs and reasonable attorney's fees.
rules.penalty: Forfeiture of deposit retention rights; treble damages plus 5% interest, costs and attorney's fees.
